parameters.name: AINodeNum
parameters.description: The number of AINodes to be deleted.

parameters.name: AINodePoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the AINode resource pool.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: NodeNames
parameters.description: The list of AINodes to be deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb delete-ai-node --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --ai-node-pool-id aipool-xxxx --ai-node-num 1 --node-names ai-xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
